name: Oliete (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue chevron from the hoist bearing a yellow castle, and two blue wavy stripes edged yellow to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Oliete; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron issuing from the hoist corners and pointing to the fly
two wavy stripes edged yellow to the fly
